eval_feedback: With the skill, the agent collapsed the L1 storage-description and L3 affordance-catalog discovery steps into a single CLI call (`solid-pod wiki-search`). This is the intended behavior — the skill encapsulates the discovery chain — but it means trajectory-based L1/L3-discovery assertions will fail by design. The outcome assertions (multi-hit count, hub recognition) and the substantive L3 assertions (search-grep invocation, OSLC quoting) all passed. Consider relaxing L1-storage-description and L3-affordance-catalog assertions when grading with-skill runs, or adding a 'skill-encapsulates-discovery' variant that passes when the CLI is invoked correctly.
